# NOT THE FILE BEING SERVED.
#
# /robots.txt is generated by pages/api/robots.js and routed there by a
# beforeFiles rewrite in next.config.js, so that the Sitemap line follows
# NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL instead of hard-coding a domain, and so a preview
# deployment can answer "Disallow: /" rather than inviting Google to index a
# staging copy of the site.
#
# This file is kept, with correct rules for the production domain, only as a
# fallback: if that rewrite is ever removed, Next serves this and the site
# still has a valid robots.txt instead of a 404. Keep the two in sync.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /*?q=
Disallow: /*&q=

Sitemap: https://rojgarhub.in/sitemap.xml
